dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: *sigh* If only Cardinal Seamus were still here...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Good day to you, Honorary Knight. I am Anselm, a member of the Knights of Favonius's expeditionary force. I am also the supervisor on duty at this stronghold.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: I was the captain of the 6th Company before I was sent out on expedition. Now, I assist the Grand Master with the expeditionary force's administrative affairs.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: ...I am also in charge of looking for the Grand Master when he goes missing.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Cardinal Seamus?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Cardinal Seamus is currently dealing with other matters, and we have taken over some administrative duties in the meantime... He was basically the only person taking care of everything before we stepped in.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Nannina, Laurent, and I have been taking turns to cover for him. But, try as we might, it is often difficult to keep up.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: They say that Master Jean, who stayed behind in Mondstadt, handles virtually all of the Knights' affairs, big and small... It really is a case of like father, like daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Cardinal Seamus?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Cardinal Seamus has returned to Mondstadt. Previously, he was virtually the only person handling all of the expeditionary force's administrative work.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: After he left, Nannina, Laurent, and I have been taking turns to cover for him. But, try as we might, it is often difficult to keep up.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: They say that Master Jean, who stayed behind in Mondstadt, handles virtually all of the Knights' affairs, big and small... It really is a case of like father, like daughter.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What has the expeditionary force been up to recently?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: The expeditionary force is currently dispersed throughout Nod-Krai, conducting operations against various threats: the Wild Hunt, the Fatui...

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: While we've dealt with quite a few troublesome enemies on this long expedition... this is the first time we've encountered a place this chaotic.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: But, as the Grand Master once said, the Knights' responsibilities are the same no matter where we are: aid the distressed and help the poor, punish the wicked and champion the good.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What has the expeditionary force been up to recently?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: This expedition is finally coming to an end, and many of our Knights can't wait to go home.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: However, per the Grand Master's orders, this camp is to remain operational as an outpost for gathering Abyss-related intel.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Several of our Knights have already volunteered to stay behind... To be honest, I am somewhat surprised by the number. We even had to draw lots to determine who would take the first round of duty.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: I will also stay behind with them to finish the work of setting up this stronghold.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Goodbye, Honorary Knight, and may the Anemo Archon protect you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Don't you miss home?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Ha! A Knight feels at home wherever the wind blows.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: And it's not like we'll never get to go home. There will be other Knights coming from Mondstadt to relieve us.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: What's one more round of duty after the long expedition we've already been through?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Where'd he sneak off to...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is it this time? Did some cat or dog wander off again?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Nope, it's the Grand Master. He disappeared again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Seriously? How does a full-grown man of his stature just disappear?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: He was like that even back in Mondstadt. Once the Knights' documents stacked higher than his head, there's a chance he'd disappear.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Sounds like an urban legend... Want us to help look for him?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Hmm... There aren't any urgent documents that require immediate attention at the moment. No need to go out of your way to look for him, he'll return when he's had enough rest.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: But if you happen to see him anywhere, give him a nudge to hurry up!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Varka disappeared again, didn't he.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: ...Ahem. Same as always, if you spot him anywhere, please give him a nudge to hurry up!

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Thanks for bringing him back! Right, I've to make the most of him before he runs off again... Wring as much work out of him as I can...
